integrity: The norm, invariant-sheaf, and function-field arguments are theoretical. The bundled verifier checks only the finite characteristic-two monomial algebra and degree arithmetic.
scientific_limitations: The result computes the complete bi-anticanonical system and a seven-dimensional subspace of global one-forms, but it does not determine the full Hodge diamond, the Picard group, or whether h^0(X,Omega_X^1)=7 is an equality.
title: The bi-anticanonical map of the irregular Fano fourfold has degree \(8\)
